[0-9]+ passed; 0 failed" /tmp/chg003_verify_test.log | awk "{print \$4}"); if [ "$lib" != "412" ]; then echo "UNEXPECTED LIB PASS COUNT: ${lib:-none}"; exit 1; fi; if ! grep -q "^test app::root::conversation_tests::inline_and_modal_replies_share_history_and_keep_other_chats_out_of_prompts \.\.\. ok$" /tmp/chg003_verify_test.log; then echo "MISSING: repaired conversation test"; exit 1; fi; spawn=$(grep -cE "^test app::spawn::tests::[a-z_]+ \.\.\. ok$" /tmp/chg003_verify_test.log); if [ "$spawn" != "4" ]; then echo "SPAWN UNIT TESTS: $spawn"; exit 1; fi; uitest=$(grep -cE "^test app::root::board_tests::open_workspace_(spawns_a_detached_sibling_without_touching_the_session|spawn_failure_warns_with_path_and_leaves_the_session_usable) \.\.\. ok$" /tmp/chg003_verify_test.log); if [ "$uitest" != "2" ]; then echo "OPEN_WORKSPACE UI TESTS: $uitest"; exit 1; fi; integ=$(grep -cE "^test (approved_feature_generates_dependent_tasks_for_distinct_repositories|interview_approval_multicall_generation_commit_and_failure_recovery) \.\.\. ok$" /tmp/chg003_verify_test.log); if [ "$integ" != "2" ]; then echo "INTEGRATION TESTS: $integ"; exit 1; fi; echo "VERIFY_CARGO_TEST_OK: 412 lib (incl 4 spawn + 2 open_workspace UI), 2 integration, 0 failed"

command: cd "$PACKET_WORKTREE" && man=$(git diff --name-only HEAD -- Cargo.toml Cargo.lock); if [ -n "$man" ]; then echo "MANIFEST TOUCHED: $man"; exit 1; fi; files=$(git diff --name-only HEAD); if [ -z "$files" ]; then echo "NO DIFF AGAINST HEAD - integration vanished"; exit 1; fi; rogue=$(printf "%s\n" "$files" | grep -vE "^(src/ui/layout\.rs|src/ui\.rs|src/app\.rs|src/app/spawn\.rs|src/app/root\.rs|src/app/conversation_tests\.rs|src/core/turn\.rs|src/core/implementation\.rs|src/persistence/task_chats\.rs|adr/implement-chg-003-task-spawn-a-detached-second-packet-instance-fro\.md)$"); if [ -n "$rogue" ]; then echo "OUT-OF-SCOPE FILES: $rogue"; exit 1; fi; echo "VERIFY_BOUNDARY_OK: $(printf "%s\n" "$files" | wc -l | tr -d " ") files, manifest pristine"
